prefix: Cinematic vertical 9:16 frame, dark moody low-key lighting, warm film grain, red energy accents, photorealistic, shallow depth of field. Match the skin tone, charcoal cuff and thin red rim glow of the hero hand reference and the amber light and red glow of the look reference. No text, no labels, no numbers, no boxes, no captions.

P2_macro_ring.prompt: Extreme macro close-up of the tip of an index finger about to touch a rough dark stone wall, a glowing red radar ring with thin concentric circles and fine tick marks on the wall right at the fingertip, the soft dark shadow of the finger beside it.

P3_open_palm.prompt: Top-down view of an open palm, fingers slightly spread, held still against a black background, warm key light from the upper left, fine skin texture, thin red rim glow on the finger edges, calm inviting gesture.

P4_finger_trail.prompt: Side view of the right hand with extended index finger moving slowly toward an open palm, several faint ghosted copies of the finger trailing behind it showing its motion path, a thin glowing red line tracing the predicted path ahead of the fingertip, black background.

P5_xray_path.prompt: Translucent x-ray style right hand with glass-like bones and soft red glowing joints, the index finger extended along a thin glowing red predicted-path curve that ends at a small red ring target above an open palm, dark background.

P6_contact_macro.prompt: Extreme macro of an index fingertip pressing lightly into the skin of an open palm, fine skin texture, a subtle red glow at the contact point, tiny dust particles in the air, black background.

P7_brain.prompt: A translucent glass-like human head in profile with the brain visible inside, glowing red neural pathways, a bright red node at the motor area and a second red node toward the back of the brain, thin red signal lines running down the neck into the shoulder and arm. Pure black background.

P8_signal_arm.prompt: A translucent glass-like head and brain at the left fading into a translucent shoulder and arm that extends to the right, a glowing red neural signal line running from the brain down through the arm toward the hand, a bright pulse travelling along it, black background.

P10_fingertip_nerves.prompt: Extreme macro of a translucent fingertip with glowing red nerve fibres converging at the tip, a bright red pulse arriving at the fingertip pad, black background.

P11_ripple_macro.prompt: Extreme macro of an index fingertip pressing lightly into skin, concentric glowing red and cream ripple rings spreading across the skin, tiny red particles floating in the dark air, fine radar tick marks.

P14_palm_particles.prompt: An open palm lit by a warm beam, a soft cloud of tiny glowing red and cream particles fading away above the skin, calm, dark background.

P15_other_hand.prompt: A different left hand with slightly larger knuckles enters the dark frame from the right with fingers extended, out of focus, approaching from behind, while the first hand is in the foreground on the left; dark stone wall, amber beam of light.

P16_suspense.prompt: Close view of an open palm in the foreground while another index finger approaches it from the left, a faint red target ring glowing on the palm, suspenseful, shallow depth of field.

P17_surprise_macro.prompt: Extreme macro of a fingertip pressing firmly into a palm, strong bright red and cream shockwave rings and radiating spark lines exploding outward across the skin, many glowing particles, dynamic.

P18_brain_flare.prompt: Translucent human head in profile with the brain flaring intensely red at the centre, a bright red beam leaving the head toward the right, dark background.
